items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: Bix really created a new style. ... Oh, everybody talked about it.

ctx.x: Where did you hear that? Around here?

Right in Los Angeles. It wasn't made before... It was made in 1926, I believe. But when we heard that... I think he come out with two records, four sides, which was "Ida" and "Singin' The Blues" and two other tunes, I can't think of the name of them, but... Everybody wanted.... That was a distinctly new style. Bix really created a new style.
Did you ever talk to Mutt about Bix Beiderbecke or that record of...
